full_details: In the morning Richard tied his own bundle and told you the skins were in and the money was not. In the afternoon your mother packed lavender and salt bacon, and Anne knotted the off-side strap. At the fire Susanna wanted a book with no riddles, Judith a song the lane does not have, and Hamnet was satisfied about the sword. Edmund was told that fifteen is for school. The tables that night held two words.
one_sentence: Each child asked one thing from London, your father sang half a catch and stopped, and Anne counted four shillings that should come home.
title: One thing from each child, and four shillings home
